messages:
alyssa: FYI found a GitHub App token string in an archived CI artifact from 2025-11-02. Artifact path: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/ci/archived/2025-11-02/3456
mike: where specifically in the artifact? logs / env dump / other?
alyssa: in a gzipped build log: build-20251102.log.gz. it looks like a script printed env vars on failure. quick check: `zcat build-20251102.log.gz | grep -E "ghu_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}"` returned the token and a few lines of context.
sasha: is it a user PAT or an app installation token? scopes?
alyssa: appears to be a GitHub App installation token (prefix ghu_) with scopes repo:contents and issues. not for workflows but still sensitive.
jen: I've revoked that installation token and rotated the app credentials. new secrets are stored in KMS and deployed via the secrets-sync job.
deploy-bot: token_revoke: OK -- github-app-installation-id=98765 user=jen timestamp=1790011260
mike: nice. confirm whether the app could write workflow files or create actions? if yes, consider workflow-injection.
jen: checked app permissions: repo:contents, issues only. no write permissions to .github/workflows. the token was used for artifact read/write.
alyssa: how many artifacts might be affected? I scanned the artifact index for that date and found 14 artifacts across 4 repos with similar logs.
sasha: we should run a retroactive scan across archived artifacts (last 90 days) for any gh* tokens and search repo history for accidental commits with keys.
mike: also add CI output pattern scanning (env dumps, verbose curl output) to detection rules.
jen: kicking off a full artifact scan now. command: `for f in $(artifact-find --since 90d); do zcat "$f" | grep -E "gh[pua]_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}" && echo FOUND:$f; done`
security-bot: retro-scan job started by jen (job id: retro-scan-20251102-01). will post summary when finished.
alyssa: containment actions taken: 1) revoked token 2) rotated app creds 3) disabled public artifact access 4) temporarily changed artifact retention from 180d -> 30d pending review.
mike: we should also mask GH token patterns in runner logs and update runner redaction to prevent env prints.
sasha: opened PR to update runner redaction regex and config: https://git.internal/redwood/runner-config/pulls/482
jen: tickets filed:
- SEC-1123: retro artifact scanning + findings review (assignee: jen)
- INF-887: runner env redaction & log masking (assignee: sasha)
- IAM-404: RBAC guard to limit who can update workflow files (assignee: mike)
- COMMS-211: customer-facing notification prep if customer repos are impacted (assignee: alyssa)
mike: KMS follow-up: ensure the app's secrets are readable only by the app service account and enable KMS access logs into the audit pipeline. confirm key policy and rotation schedule.
alyssa: added to SEC-1123: verify KMS key policy, check cross-account grants, and confirm rotation cadence.
jen: retro-scan completed. summary: 14 artifacts matched pattern, 2 unique tokens found, both revoked, no commits with embedded tokens detected. uploading full report to SEC-1123.
security-bot: retro-scan-20251102-01: completed. findings=14 artifacts, unique_tokens=2, revoked=2, commits_leaked=0
mike: next actions: 1) close immediate incident 2) run gitleaks/trufflehog across repos for last year 3) schedule postmortem and update incident runbook.
alyssa: agreed. postmortem ticket PM-5463 created and assigned to mike. draft timeline at https://docs.internal/postmortems/PM-5463
sasha: i'll merge the runner config PR once CI passes and deploy to canary.
jen: infra notified; i'm following up on artifact retention rollback and will update SEC-1123.
alyssa: postmortem will include remediation (log masking, KMS audit logs, RBAC for workflow edits, artifact retention policy change, regular retro scan cadence). we'll publish a summary to all-hands and the security newsletter after PM-5463 closes.
mike: good catch and quick response. closing here pending PM-5463 follow-up. :white_check_mark:
jen: SEC-1123 linked to PM-5463 and COMMS-211. will post updates when the postmortem is published. :thumbsup:
